map.木本（月季/绣球）可略多加糖促开放；敏感花（非洲菊/鸢尾）糖量宜低；水面以下叶要: Woody stems (rose, hydrangea) can take slightly more sugar to open faster; sensitive flowers (gerbera, iris) want less sugar; remove all leaves below the waterline, recut 1-2 cm daily and keep out of direct sun with airflow. These matter more for vase life than the recipe alone.
